title: Karumi vs Qualified: what are the differences?
summary: Qualified Piper or Karumi? Compare Piper for Sales with Karumi's AI demo agent on sales calls and your website: demos, CRMs, languages and setup.
body_markdown:
Qualified Piper is an AI agent from Qualified, a Salesforce company, that qualifies website visitors and books meetings, and[Piper for Sales](https://www.qualified.com/piper-for-sales) , announced in November 2026, extends it to Zoom and Google Meet sales calls from Q1 2027. Karumi is an AI demo agent that runs your real product live, on your website and on your sales calls in Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams, and our own team has had it on real calls for a year.


If you are looking at Piper for Sales, or for a Piper for Sales alternative, here is how the two compare. Both put an AI agent in front of your buyers, but they are built for different jobs.


Qualified sells Piper, an **AI SDR agent** that talks with visitors over chat, voice or video, qualifies them and books meetings for your sales team, all on top of Salesforce. Karumi is an **AI demo agent** : when a visitor wants to see the product, it joins them on a live video call, shares its screen and walks them through your real product while it answers their questions.


Which one fits depends on what you want that first conversation to produce: a meeting on a rep's calendar, or the demo itself, right there. In this article, **we compare both platforms in detail** so you can decide.


## Comparison table: Karumi vs Qualified


Dimension Karumi Qualified


Core approach An AI demo agent that joins the visitor on a live video call and runs your real product while it answers their questions. An AI SDR agent (Piper) that talks with website visitors over chat, voice or video, qualifies them and books meetings for your sales team.


Showing the product The agent shares its screen and navigates your actual software, taking whichever path the buyer asks about. Piper can walk visitors through pages of your website or a preset slide deck, the way a rep would share their screen.


Sales calls Call Copilot joins your Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams calls and demos your real product when the rep or the buyer asks. Available today. Piper for Sales joins Zoom and Google Meet calls to present slides, run product demos, answer questions and book next steps. Announced in November 2026, generally available in Q1 2027.


Website chat A chat bar that answers questions, qualifies in real time and moves the visitor into a live demo in about two seconds when intent is there. Piper and your human reps chat with visitors, with proactive messages, routing to reps and meeting booking inside the conversation.


Where it runs Your website, your sales calls, inside your product, outbound emails and Slack. Your website, the inbound lead inbox by email and Slack for your team. Sales calls from Q1 2027 with Piper for Sales.


CRM Salesforce, HubSpot, Attio, monday.com and Brevo, plus webhooks for anything else. Salesforce CRM is required. HubSpot Marketing Hub, Marketo and Eloqua connect as marketing automation.


Buyer insight Every question visitors ask, in their words, plus a summary and qualification of each session in your CRM. Visitor identification, buyer intent data (Qualified Signals) and routing on live Salesforce data.


Languages 70+ languages. 16+ languages.


Pricing Self-serve and Enterprise plans, listed on karumi.ai/pricing. Not published. Sold on annual contracts, and multimodal voice and video cost extra.


Setup Your first agent is live on day 2, with no engineering on your side. A few weeks, according to Qualified. Salesforce launched Piper on its own website in 30 days.


Ownership Karumi, a Y Combinator company. Salesforce, since April 2026.


## What is Karumi?


[Karumi](https://karumi.ai/) is an[AI demo agent](https://karumi.ai/blog/agentic-demos) . It maps your whole product, stays in sync as you ship and runs a live demo for whoever is asking: a website visitor, a prospect in the middle of a deal, a new user or someone on your own team.


On your website it starts as a[chat](https://karumi.ai/chat) . The agent answers first questions and qualifies the visitor in real time. When they want to see the product, one click puts them on a[live video call](https://karumi.ai/website-demo) where the agent shares its screen and **walks them through your real product** , answering as it goes. There is no calendar link and no wait.


When the conversation ends, the agent works out where each visitor should go next (self-serve, a rep, or neither) and **writes the session to your CRM** either way.


### Key features of Karumi


- **Live demos on the real product:** The agent navigates your actual software on a video call, not screenshots or a recording.
- **Chat that turns into a demo:** The chat bar answers questions from your product knowledge and moves the visitor into a live demo in about two seconds when intent is there.
- **On your sales calls:** Call Copilot joins Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams calls and demos the product on request, with your rep in control.
- **Speak, type, interrupt:** Visitors can talk to the agent or type to it, and cut in at any point, as they would with a person.
- **Available the moment a buyer asks:** The agent runs demos 24/7, including outside business hours, when no rep would be available.
- **Every market:** The agent runs demos in 70+ languages.
- **Stays current:** Karumi maps your product and keeps learning it as you ship, so the demo matches what you have released.
- **Qualification and routing:** The agent qualifies during the conversation, sends each visitor to the right next step and syncs the transcript, summary and qualification data to Salesforce, HubSpot, Attio, monday.com or Brevo.
- **Every question, in their words:** You get a report of what visitors asked, the features they wanted and the objections they raised.
- **Enterprise security:** Karumi is SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant, with every session observable and control over what each agent can see, say and do.
- **Try it first:** You can generate a first-pass agent for free before committing.


## What is Qualified?


Qualified is the company behind Piper, **an AI SDR agent** that talks with your website visitors over chat, voice or video, qualifies them and books meetings for your sales team. It requires Salesforce CRM, and Qualified has been part of Salesforce since April 1, 2026.


It was founded in San Francisco in 2018 by Kraig Swensrud and Sean Whiteley, both former Salesforce executives, and started as conversational marketing software for B2B companies that run Salesforce: live chat, voice calls and meeting scheduling on their websites. Salesforce signed an agreement to acquire it in December 2025, closed the deal on April 1, 2026, and plans to bring Qualified's intent data, conversational AI and meeting scheduling into Agentforce, its AI agent platform.


Since the PiperX release in August 2025, Piper can appear as a digital human or as a voice-only orb. It answers from the sales materials you give it, qualifies the visitor, books the meeting and follows up with inbound leads by email. It can also walk a visitor through your website content or a preset slide deck, **the way a human rep would share their screen** . Routing, intent data and meeting booking all work off live Salesforce records.


### Key features of Qualified


- **Piper, the AI SDR agent:** It engages website visitors in real time, answers their questions, qualifies them and books meetings without a rep.
- **Piper for Sales:** Announced in November 2026, it joins Zoom and Google Meet sales calls to present, demo and book next steps. Generally available in Q1 2027.
- **Text, voice and video:** Piper can chat, speak or appear as a video avatar, and buyers can switch between modes. Custom avatars came with the Summer '26 release.
- **Email follow-up:** Piper also works the inbound lead inbox, following up with new leads by email.
- **Meeting booking:** Meetings are scheduled inside the conversation, with a full-screen booker and extra qualifying questions before the meeting is booked.
- **Routing to human reps:** High-priority visitors can go to a live rep before the agent steps in, with alerts in Slack and on mobile.
- **Visitor identification and intent data:** Qualified Signals shows which accounts are on your site and how interested they are.
- **Built on Salesforce:** Piper runs on Salesforce CRM and connects to Data 360 on the Enterprise and Ultimate plans.
- **Multilingual:** Piper can hold conversations in 16+ languages.


## Piper for Sales vs Karumi Call Copilot


In November 2026, Qualified[announced Piper for Sales](https://www.qualified.com/newsroom/qualified-introduces-piper-for-sales) , an agent that joins virtual meetings next to your sellers. According to Qualified, it presents from your slide library, runs product demos on demand, answers technical questions, switches language and books the next meeting, using context from Salesforce Sales Cloud and Data 360. Qualified says it will be generally available in Q1 2027.


Karumi has worked this way for a year. Our own team brings the agent into real sales calls, and it steps in when the conversation needs the product on screen.[Karumi Call Copilot](https://karumi.ai/products/call-copilot) joins Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams calls, runs the demo on your real product in a browser and learns every release on its own, while your rep stays in control. The same agent can also[run the whole call on its own](https://karumi.ai/products/videocall-agent) when no rep is needed.


- **Availability:** Karumi Call Copilot is available today. Piper for Sales is planned for Q1 2027.
- **Meeting platforms:** Karumi joins Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams. Qualified lists Zoom and Google Meet.
- **The demo:** Karumi navigates your live product in a browser, taking whichever path the buyer asks about. Piper for Sales presents your slides and runs product demos on request.
- **CRM:** Piper for Sales uses Salesforce Sales Cloud and Data 360. Karumi works with Salesforce, HubSpot, Attio, monday.com and Brevo.
- **One agent across the funnel:** The same Karumi agent demos on your website, in your links and on your calls.


To see how other tools compare, browse all[Karumi comparisons](https://karumi.ai/compare) or check[Karumi pricing](https://karumi.ai/pricing) .


## Karumi vs Qualified: which one should you choose?


Both tools answer buyers the moment they arrive on your site. The choice comes down to what you want that conversation to produce, and which CRM your team runs on.


### Choose Karumi if:


- **You want an AI agent on your sales calls today:** Call Copilot already joins Meet, Zoom and Teams calls, and our team has used it on real calls for a year.
- **You want buyers to see the product in the first conversation:** The agent joins them on a live call and runs your real product, instead of booking a meeting for a demo next week.
- **You are replacing your website chat:** Karumi's chat answers questions, qualifies in real time and moves the visitor into a live demo when intent is there.
- **Your CRM is not Salesforce, or not only Salesforce:** Qualified requires Salesforce CRM and is now part of Salesforce. Karumi syncs to Salesforce, HubSpot, Attio, monday.com and Brevo, plus webhooks.
- **You sell in many markets:** Karumi runs demos in 70+ languages.
- **You want to start fast:** Your first agent is live on day 2, with no engineering on your side.
- **You want to know what buyers actually ask:** Every session gives you their questions, the features they wanted and their objections, in their own words.


### Choose Qualified if:


- **Your go-to-market runs on Salesforce:** Piper qualifies and routes on live Salesforce data, and Salesforce is bringing it into Agentforce.
- **You want an AI SDR across chat and email:** Piper engages visitors on your site and follows up with inbound leads by email.
- **You want account identification and intent data in the same tool:** Qualified Signals shows which accounts are on your site and how interested they are.
- **You want human reps on your website chat too:** Qualified routes priority visitors to a live rep before the agent takes over.
- **The goal of every conversation is a booked meeting:** Piper is built to qualify and book, with scheduling inside the conversation.
- **You want Piper on your website and in your reps' meetings:** Piper for Sales extends Piper to Zoom and Google Meet calls from Q1 2027.
